ns2:section.sectionText: This class combines an intensive weekend model (2 weekends, 8 hrs/day) of face to face meetings with online modules in Illinois Compass. Face-to-face class will meet on the following Saturdays and Sundays: 2/24-2/25 and 4/7-4/8 from 9:00-5:00 in Room 2018 with time for lunch.
